title: fix(muya): give each repeated footnote reference its own id and backref
issueTitle: [Bug] Referencing the same footnote twice emits a duplicate DOM id and an unreachable backlink
why: The bug is a duplicate DOM id and a backlink that cannot be reached, which shows mainly in HTML/PDF export; turning on the footnote option needs the Preferences window, and the report does not say what the in-editor footnote should look like once fixed.
